specification.title: Benign organization domain end-to-end
specification.description: A legitimate organization domain with benign infrastructure, ambient DNS noise, and explicit no-result provider outcomes. The production investigation must reach a terminal benign Assessment without inventing a malicious conclusion, traverse boundedly, and persist a faithful report.
specification.purpose: Verify the production end-to-end path does not invent maliciousness: clean reputation, no malicious association, bounded traversal, and a faithful report that preserves the benign verdict.
specification.operational_relevance: Benign domains vastly outnumber malicious ones; a production pipeline that fabricates threats erodes operator trust.
specification.regression_risk: The pipeline could over-investigate clean infrastructure, invent a malicious association from shared hosting, or persist a report that contradicts the benign Assessment.

required: The investigation reaches a terminal benign Assessment
The final report preserves the benign verdict and confidence
Traversal stays within the authored depth and action bounds
forbidden: The investigation invents a malicious conclusion or malware association
The report contradicts the benign Assessment
